summary: Share-immediate security review: 0 critical. No video upload; share remains user-initiated (Export/Share click starts async startExport → await encode → deliverExportFile/shareVideoFile; onstop File-only); secret scan clean; AbortError → aborted with no UI/stack leak; WebM/MP4 MIME honesty unchanged. Free-leaderboard trust boundary still open/out of scope.

findings.issue: No upload: share-immediate path has zero fetch/XHR/sendBeacon/WebSocket/FormData/upload. deliverExportFile only calls injectable share or download; downloadBlob is createObjectURL + <a download>; shareVideoFile calls navigator.share with local File. Delta touches no app/app/api, db, prisma, or middleware.

findings.issue: Share still user-initiated: MediaRecorder.onstop only resolves File (no share/download). shareVideoFile runs after await encodePromise inside startExport, which is started only from Export/Share click (void startExport()). findings.issue: Secret scan clean: no api keys, INTERNAL_TOKEN, Stripe secrets, or private key material in delta. No package.json / lockfile changes. pnpm audit highs are pre-existing (undici via firebase/blob, etc.) — out of scope.

AbortError quiet: isAbortError maps err.name === 'AbortError' → { reason: 'aborted' } with no message field and no err.stack. learnings.insight: Share-immediate security review: 0 critical, 0 warning, 6 info. Confirmed no upload; click→await encode→share chain (onstop File-only); secrets clean; AbortError quiet; MIME-honest container types; climb/result untouched.
learnings.action: Proceed to qa-acceptance; do not loopBack to implementer for security.

learnings.insight: Share-first after async MediaRecorder is still a user-initiated trust boundary when: (1) click starts the async function, (2) onstop only resolves File, (3) share/download run after await in that same function or a later Share click, (4) AbortError maps to reason enum without message/stack, (5) no network upload of bytes.
learnings.action: When reviewing share-immediate deltas, verify onstop File-only + deliverExportFile after await encodePromise; reject fire-and-forget share from onstop; keep no-fetch grep.
